messages:
Ava (events): Quick pre-check for Wed's webinar — need to lock down registration confirmation + replay flow. Who's on Zoom settings?
Diego (growth): I can take Zoom. Plan: cloud recording + transcript, alternative host set to ops@redwood.ai, and disable join before host.
Priya (content): For the registration page we said Typeform. Can we include a field for 'current infra pain' so SDRs can segment?
Sam (ops): +1 on Typeform. Zap will send Typeform -> HubSpot contact + add tag `webinar_march2026` -> append to `marketing:webinar-registrants` sheet. I'll update the zap.
Maya (prod marketing): Replay gating question: public replay or gated for registrants only? My recommendation: gated for 7 days, then public. Keeps urgency but increases reach later.
Ava (events): Agree gated 7 days. Replay email should go automatically once recording is processed. ZoomBot: Recording finished notifications are ~15-20m after end.
Diego (growth): Routing for inbound leads: if company size >50 and job title contains (engineer|ml|platform) -> create hot lead in HubSpot and ping #sales-inbound. Can Sam add that to the zap/hubspot workflow?
Sam (ops): Yup. HubSpot workflow rule snippet: `IF form:registrant AND company_size > 50 AND role matches regex (engineer|ml|platform) THEN create task 'webinar hot lead' assigned to regional AE`. I'll implement today.
Priya (content): Draft of confirmation email subject/body (short):
```
Subject: You're registered — Redwood Inference: Scaling inference without the ops headache
Hi {{first_name}},
Thanks for registering for "Serving LLMs for production" on Mar 25. We'll email a calendar invite and a replay link after the session. In the meantime, here are the top pre-reads: [1] latency primer, [2] cost controls guide.
```
Ava (events): Nice. Add a CTA for prep question: "What is your top inference bottleneck?" — we'll pipe answers to HubSpot property `webinar_pain_point`.
Maya (prod marketing): Also include an optional checkbox to receive product updates — GDPR clean.
Diego (growth): Recording asset storage: put raw cloud recording + transcript in GCS: `gs://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-03-25/` and a processed MP4 in `replay/processed/`. Sam can the zap upload link to HubSpot contact record?
Sam (ops): Yes. Zap flow: Zoom cloud recording -> webhook -> lambda that transcodes (30m max) -> upload to GCS -> update HubSpot with `replay_url`. I'll add the processed path.
Priya (content): Post-event sequence (brief): Day0: thank-you + replay (gated), Day2: highlights + TL;DR + resource links, Day7: public replay email + CTA to demo, Day21: nurture with benchmark report.
Ava (events): Who's owning post-event Slack alert for attendees from target accounts? We should ping #sales-inbound with a short summary + list of hot leads.
Diego (growth): I'll set the HubSpot webhook to post a compact JSON to #sales-inbound via our bot. Fields: name, company, role, company_size, pain_point, replay_url.
Maya (prod marketing): One more ask: can we attach a short 2-slide one-pager for AEs to use when they follow up? Priya can you draft?
Priya (content): On it, will drop draft in /drive/marketing/webinars/2026-03-25/AE-onepager.pdf by EOD Tuesday.
Ava (events): Action items quick list: Ava: confirm calendar invite template; Diego: Zoom settings & webhook; Sam: zap + HubSpot workflow; Priya: emails + one-pager; Maya: follow-up cadence + GDPR checkbox. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
Sam (ops): Implementing zap + HubSpot rules now — will ping when test registration goes through.
Diego (growth): Zoom settings I set now: cloud recording (active speaker), enable auto-transcription, disable participant recording, alternative host ops@redwood.ai, approval for attendees: none, waiting room on.
Ava (events): Awesome. If ZoomBot posts recording notification, I'll queue the replay email. Thanks all :pray:
